messages.subject: analiza podatkov v populacijski genetiki
messages.body_plain:
Če koga zanima analiza podatkov v populacijski genetiki, imajo na severu tečaj ravno za té.

After an introduction to phylogenetic reconstruction, the course will cover a number of multivariate approaches for the analysis of genetic patterns, including supervised and unsupervised factorial methods, clustering approaches, and advanced methods for describing population diversity and revealing spatial genetic patterns. The approaches introduced will be applicable to most genetic data, including markers such as microsatellites, SNPs, or AFLP, as well as nucleotide and amino-acid sequence data.

Zadeva ni zastojn, draga pa tudi ni (če primerjam z drugimi tečaji). Predavatelji so sami top notch (avtorji R paketa adegenet), meni pa je všeč poudarek na ponovljivem raziskovanju.

http://www.prstatistics.com/course/reproducible-data-science-for-population-genetics-rdpg01/

​lp,
Roman​

--
In God we trust, all others bring data.
